details:
VRChat becomes unresponsive immediately after I enable or interact with the OSC setting.

Build:

VRChat 2026.2.2p2-1855-4c1f48c1eb-Release

Store: Steam

Platform: Windows standalone

Mode: Desktop / --no-vr

System:

OS: Windows 11 64-bit

CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D

GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti

RAM: 64 GB

Steps to reproduce:

Make sure OSC is disabled / reset the OSC PlayerPrefs value to 0.

Launch VRChat from Steam in desktop mode with --no-vr.

Log in and enter a world.

Open Settings and enable or interact with the OSC setting.

VRChat freezes / becomes unresponsive.

After force-closing the client, VRChat may continue freezing on launch until the OSC PlayerPrefs registry value is reset.

Observed result:

After enabling or interacting with OSC, this PlayerPrefs value changes from 0 to 1:

HKCU\Software\VRChat\vrchat

UI.Settings.Osc_h1043380067

Normal / recoverable state:

UI.Settings.Osc_h1043380067 = 0

Broken state:

UI.Settings.Osc_h1043380067 = 1

Resetting only this value back to 0 allows VRChat to launch again:

REG ADD HKCU\Software\VRChat\vrchat /v "UI.Settings.Osc_h1043380067" /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

Expected result:

Enabling OSC should not freeze the client. If OSC initialization fails, VRChat should remain responsive and should not get stuck in a broken launch state.

Additional testing:

I already tried common troubleshooting such as driver updates, reinstall/removal steps, and registry reset.

No process appeared to be using UDP 9000 or 9001 before launch.

There was no existing OSC folder/config to clear.

I tested a separate local profile and different OSC ports using:

--profile=1 --osc=9010:127.0.0.1:9011

The launch options were applied, but enabling OSC still froze the client.

Minimal registry diff showing the OSC PlayerPrefs value change

title: Enabling OSC freezes VRChat; PlayerPrefs UI.Settings.Osc_h1043380067 set to 1 causes client hang
